want.mark_published: UPDATE "public"."edax_ingest_rejections" SET value = jsonb_set(value, '{published}', 'true'::jsonb) WHERE key = $1::text AND value->>'fingerprint' = $2::text AND starts_with(key, $3::text) RETURNING key

want.read_rejections: SELECT key, value::text AS value FROM "public"."edax_ingest_rejections" WHERE key IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb)) ORDER BY key
want.read_rejections_for_plan: SELECT saved.key, (CASE WHEN input.value->>'raw_fingerprint' IS NULL THEN saved.value ELSE jsonb_set(saved.value, '{raw}', input.value->'raw') END)::text AS value FROM "public"."edax_ingest_rejections" AS saved JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (value->>'source') value FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS inputs(value, position) ORDER BY value->>'source', position) AS input ON saved.key = input.value->>'source' ORDER BY saved.key
want.read_state: SELECT key, value::text AS value FROM "public"."edax_ingest_state" WHERE key IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb)) ORDER BY key
want.read_state_metadata: SELECT key, (value - 'value')::text AS value FROM "public"."edax_ingest_state" WHERE key IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb)) ORDER BY key
want.write_events: INSERT INTO "public"."edax_ingest_events" AS target (key, value) SELECT key, value FROM jsonb_each($1::jsonb) ORDER BY key COLLATE "C" ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value
want.write_rejections: INSERT INTO "public"."edax_ingest_rejections" AS target (key, value) SELECT key, value FROM jsonb_each($1::jsonb) ORDER BY key COLLATE "C" ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING
want.write_state: INSERT INTO "public"."edax_ingest_state" AS target (key, value) SELECT key, value FROM jsonb_each($1::jsonb) ORDER BY key COLLATE "C" ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value
